title: The structure-morphism mate with the identity factor
statement:
Use the Poincare duality data [def-pod-conventions] at any of the four coefficient stages. Let $a:X\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ be the exceptionally admissible structure morphism, let $a_s=\operatorname{id}_s$, and use the ordinary and exceptional adjunctions [fix-prop-adjunctions]. Put $w=Ra_s^!\Lambda_s$ and $\omega=Ra^!\Lambda_s$. Let $u:w\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda_s$ be the identity-adjunction counit isomorphism of [lem-pod-point-dualizing-complex]. Form the canonical mate
$$m:Ra^!Ra_s^!\Lambda_s\xrightarrow{\sim}R(a_s\circ a)^!\Lambda_s=\omega$$
of the compact-support composition comparison [thm-sf-comp-composition], with the pasted exceptional units and counits of [fix-prop-adjunctions](3). Under the identity normalization of $Ra_{s!}$ and its right adjoint, this specified mate satisfies $m=Ra^!u$. This assertion uses completed adjunctions integrally, their scalar localization at $E$, and their common finite-stage forms at $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$.

source.place: Step 1, the composite-adjunction mate at a_Y = id_s, with its identity normalization
